description: This PHP script handles viewing event information within the TestLink project. It initializes the page, retrieves event and user data from the database based on request arguments, and displays the event details using a Smarty template. It also includes functions for argument initialization and user rights checking.

classes.name: tlEvent
classes.description: Represents an event entity with methods to load data from the database.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user entity with methods to verify user permissions.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template engine class used to assign variables and render templates.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns the arguments for page processing, specifically the event ID.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to view the events page.
